content: {"episode_id":"ep-05197","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-50 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry) for this episode, as the clinical indication note documents a patient presenting with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, which are concerning for arrhythmia in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0, with palpitations coded R00.2). The note states that mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptoms with potential cardiac events over an extended monitoring period, which directly addresses the payer's finding that documentation did not sufficiently establish the requirement for continuous ambulatory monitoring over the specified period. We request reconsideration of the medical necessity determination for the outstanding balance of 709.25 based on this documented indication."}
